title: 43_Love_and_War

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever messed with a rival?
options: I did what I had to do.

question_options.question: Do you want Howard to get back together with Linda?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That `is` gross. I almost feel bad for Linda...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] gross. I almost feel bad for Linda...

nodes.text: Later that day, Linda's sitting with Howard in the library while Jessica and Sam watch...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh... Linda... Don't take this the wrong way, but did you get sprayed by a skunk?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get hit by a rotten egg?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you pack decomposing meat in your lunch?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It must be my shampoo... I just washed my hair in gym class. I don't know what's wrong with it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh... I think I'm going to be sick.
Howard runs off!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha ha! Nice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. We definitely got Linda away from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't wait to see her face...
Later that day, Sam and Jessica wait for Linda to show up in the library...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! Come sit over here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Linda!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! What gives?! I thought we put the dye in her shampoo!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We did... Oh, rats. Linda's got dark hair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Um, hello? You've got to bleach dark hair before you can dye it, especially with neon colors.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hot green isn't even going to show up on her hair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you couldn't have told me this sooner?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm blonde! How am I supposed to remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, forget it. We'll just have to figure out something else to do to her.
The lock pops open!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nothing to it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, we're in. This is her shampoo bottle. What do you want to put in it?

nodes.prompt: What do you want to put in it?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to put in it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we did our best... I guess we'll just have to wait and see if the gossip spreads...
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Time to listen in on the gossip in the hallways... Someone `must` have heard something about all the guys Linda made out with!
nodes.text_bbcode: Time to listen in on the gossip in the hallways... Someone [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] have heard something about all the guys Linda made out with!

nodes.text: Sam leans around the corner and listens in...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! What's wrong? Are you avoiding me or something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, Linda, you can do whatever you want, okay? I don't care how many guys you hook up with. But don't expect me to be happy about it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh? What are you talking about?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, the rumors are all over school. I just need a break from all this drama, all right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: S... Sure...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Perfect! Her reputation is totally ruined with Howard.
Howard walks away, and Linda leans up against the lockers, tears filling her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, what's with the water works?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Kenji... I guess you believe all the rumors too.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Rumors? Nah, I never listen to school gossip. Just a bunch of lies, you know?
Kenji puts an arm around Linda and pulls her close.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Just take it easy, okay? It's all going to blow over.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa, Hector, did you hear about all the fries that Linda baked trout with?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She had a cookout and didn't invite us?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no! Something must've gotten mixed up. This rumor was a total disaster.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess it's back to the drawing board.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What?! Are you kidding?! I absolutely did not kiss Linda!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's it. I've heard enough.
Jacob stands up and storms off.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Huh. You really got under his skin...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ohmygoodness! I bet you really `did` catch him with Linda!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygoodness! I bet you really [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] catch him with Linda!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er... Exactly! He's protesting a little `too` much, don't you think?
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... Exactly! He's protesting a little [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] much, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I can't wait to tell everyone I know!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait... Is that the Auto-Shop guy with the long, black hair?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh. Wait, who's Jacob, then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just forget it. All you need to remember is that Linda made out with a lot of guys, okay? Just try to remember that and tell your friends.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh. Okay.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, wait a second. I was with Zach at the gym that day. There's no way he could've seen Linda.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... I mean... Maybe it was the day before that.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh, it's so disappointing when people can't get their facts straight. How am I supposed to tell Mona about this if I don't have specific dates.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was the day before that! I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Zach? You mean that guy on the football team?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! That's him!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But why is she making out with him if she was making out with that other guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because she's a mean, horrible girl! She just goes around breaking hearts.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This Linda doesn't seem very nice at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's terrible! Make sure you warn all of your friends about her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, that's not all. I heard she totally made out with someone else the day before.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda also made out with...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What?! Mallika is going to freak out!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can't believe Phil would do that... He knows how much it would bother Howard...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Who?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That guy right over there! Ugh, I swear, some freshmen don't know `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That guy right over there! Ugh, I swear, some freshmen don't know [color=#3b78e2][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ewww! That's so gross. I don't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, it's crazy, right?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, I mean, I `really` don't believe it.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] don't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, believe whatever you want, that's what happened!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know that guy who taped mistletoe above the girls' locker room and then hid in the bushes and jumped out whenever a hot girl walked by?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ew ew ew! Who would make out with `that` creep?! This Linda chick must be totally desperate!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew ew ew! Who would make out with [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] creep?! This Linda chick must be totally desperate!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, it's sad, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Definitely.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, now for a good rumor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yesterday, I saw Linda making out with...
Sam and Jessica sit down next to Jacob and Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, guys. Did you hear the latest gossip about Linda?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Gossip about Linda? OMG! Let's hear it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, talking to freshmen... I guess it has to be done.
Sam and Jessica sit down at a table of freshmen.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Cheerleaders? What do you guys want?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We just wanted to see if you little freshmen have heard the latest rumors about Linda...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Linda? Who's Linda?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That girl over there! She's popular! `Everyone` knows who she is.
nodes.text_bbcode: That girl over there! She's popular! [color=#3b78e2][i]Everyone[/i][/color] knows who she is.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoa, calm down. Okay, sure, I see her. What's the gossip?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't... What number...?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, I thought you said you could handle this!
The bell rings! Girls start running in...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, what are you doing with Linda's locker?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, what? This is Linda's locker? I had no idea!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure...
Sam and Jessica turn and quickly walk back to their gym lockers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that could have gone better.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We're out of time. You're going to have to think of something else to do to Linda.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know Linda has gym next period. What if we break into her locker and switch out her shampoo for something else?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love it! I have some neon green dye left over from when I was a hot highlighter for Halloween. I bet Linda would totally freak if her hair got dyed neon green.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A hot highlighter?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not everyone can pull it off.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Or if you'd rather do something else, I also have this totally gross perfume that one of my ex-boyfriends gave me. We can put it in her shampoo.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But anyway, I guess first we have to break into her locker. Let's ditch the rest of gym class and sneak into the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heh heh. Okay!
Back in the locker room...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Here's Linda's locker.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shh... I just need to spin the dial to hear where the lock clicks... Okay, 45... 71... 23...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever you're doing, you better hurry. We don't have all day before class is over and everyone comes back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Um, hello? I'm not even `friends` with your dweeby little cousin.
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, hello? I'm not even [color=#3b78e2][i]friends[/i][/color] with your dweeby little cousin.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't call $ZOE dweeby! Only `I` get to call her dweeby!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't call $ZOE dweeby! Only [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] get to call her dweeby!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoa, there, cowgirl. You're asking `me` for a favor, remember? I think you better change your tone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, there, cowgirl. You're asking [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] for a favor, remember? I think you better change your tone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'm sorry. Look, I could really use a partner for this. Will you help me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, all right... But you owe me one, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great... I hope I didn't just get in over my head... Well, with any luck, maybe Jessica will forget all about this.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what did you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oooo... I `love` manipulating people.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oooo... I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] manipulating people.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I love Cupid, angels, hearts, and flowers.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine, I'll help! What did you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oops! We'd better get to class!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, let's go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE's too sweet for her own good... And she's not going to get Howard by sitting back and letting Linda throw herself at him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't matter what she says... I'm going to help $ZOE... One day, she'll thank me for this!
Later that day during gym class...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica! I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Huh? What do you need help with?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I need to help my cousin, $ZOE. She's crazy about Howard, but with Linda getting in the way, she doesn't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hold on a second. Didn't you totally have a crush on Howard earlier this year? Why are you so ready to help your cousin?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please, that was at the very beginning of the year! It was just a little crush, and I'm totally over it now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, I'd rather Howard hook up with $ZOE than with Linda.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE's been my best friend these past few weeks. She got me on the cheerleading squad. I never would have made it through Spirit Week without her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's been so nice to me! And after I've been so mean to her, even when we were little... Now, I've got a chance to make up for some of that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what do you say? Will you help me get Linda out of the way?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hmm... I `am` always up for ruining someone's life. But what's in it for me?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] always up for ruining someone's life. But what's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You get...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh? What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just trust me. I've got a few ideas for how we can get the message across.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, Sam! You don't have to go through any trouble for me. If Howard `really` wants to be with Linda... Well... Maybe he should be.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, Sam! You don't have to go through any trouble for me. If Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] wants to be with Linda... Well... Maybe he should be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's really sweet that you'd try to help me.
$ZOE hugs Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What you really need to do is ruin Linda. Ruin her reputation, ruin her popularity, and ruin her chances with Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! That's terrible!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could `never` do something like that to `anyone.` Even Linda.
nodes.text_bbcode: I could [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] do something like that to [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone.[/i][/color] Even Linda.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine, fine. I guess I should have known better.
Later that day, Sam spots Kenji running toward Linda...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda! Hey! I saw what you did on FaceSpace...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh?
Kenji sweeps Linda up in a big hug and kisses her.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji! What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You requested to be in a relationship with me. This is me accepting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's going on here? Linda, I thought you said things were through with Kenji, and now you're kissing him?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Things `are` through with me and Kenji.
nodes.text_bbcode: Things [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] through with me and Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What? But... You changed your FaceSpace profile...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `No`, I did `not!` I have no idea what you're talking about!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No[/i][/color], I did [color=#3b78e2][i]not![/i][/color] I have no idea what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: On FaceSpace... I saw...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, I didn't request to be in a relationship with you... It must be some kind of prank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, it's a prank. Or maybe you just changed your mind... Again.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, it wasn't like that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, Linda, I just don't know what to believe right now, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll admit that some of the changes to your profile were a little far-fetched...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oops... Guess I should've toned it down a little.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But how can I know that I can really trust you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard...
Howard turns and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I've been trying `really` hard to forget about how you left me for Kenji...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I've been trying [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] hard to forget about how you left me for Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And seeing a happy picture of the two of you on your FaceSpace profile didn't exactly make that easier.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You've got to believe me... It was just a stupid prank!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That photo was real. It doesn't matter who put it up. You took him to our favorite restaurant, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what makes it even worse is how happy you looked. You and Kenji were happy together... Really happy. How do you think that makes me feel?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard...
Howard turns and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, that was `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, that was [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So... A prank, huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whatever. Forget it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's see her photos... Perfect, here's one of her and Kenji from a few months ago! They're at some romantic French restaurant. Just a few clicks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And now it's her profile picture! Everyone's going to think they just took this picture!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Exactly. And even if they figure it out, it'll be a huge reminder to Howard about all the time Linda spent in Kenji's arms. Let's go before Ms. Prez gets over here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's see... Favorite book... 'Meditation and the Art of Motorcycle Racing'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Favorite song... 'I'm Dating That Guy From Auto-Shop'.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is that even a real song?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Favorite activity... 'Making out with Kenji.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Perfect.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not exactly subtle...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: War is never subtle. Let's go before Ms. Prez gets over here.
Kat furiously types in the words Sam tells her...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: There! I'm in! My program did it! Hah.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I knew that algorithm that combined shortened nicknames with common adorable animals would pay off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awesome. Thanks, Kat.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: No problem. What are you going to do to her profile?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to make everyone think she and Kenji are back together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That should make Howard think twice about getting involved with her again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First, we're going to set her status to 'In a relationship with Kenji'.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Devious! I like it! Howard's definitely going to see that, and he'll think they're back together!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then we're going to...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Whatever you need to do, make it quick! Ms. Prez is headed this way! If she catches you on FaceSpace on the school computer, you'll get detention.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I'm out of here. Good luck.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Time to think fast! I better pick one last thing to do to Linda's profile...

nodes.prompt: I better pick one last thing to do to Linda's profile...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I better pick one last thing to do to Linda's profile...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda likes... Um... Bread?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: This isn't working. You just don't know Linda well enough to use this program. Sorry, guys.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, that was a disaster. I guess this is a lost cause.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least we gave it our best shot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Too bad it wasn't good enough.
Kat sits down at the computer and plugs in a thumb drive.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: First, I need to copy over the program... There. Now, we need to give the program something to go off of.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Give me some words that you think might be in Linda's password. This software will run through every combination of capitalization and numbering with those words.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're totally pretty. If you just lose the glasses, you'd be majorly hot.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Haha! Really? Well, I hate to break it to you, but the way I look `is` majorly hot for the nerd crew.
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha! Really? Well, I hate to break it to you, but the way I look [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] majorly hot for the nerd crew.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: A girl with glasses and some computer skills? I'm set.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: But that was really sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Will you help us?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Why not? I could use some recreational hacking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ever wanted to go out with a popular guy? We can totally set you up with Keith or Hector or somebody.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: A date?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah. So, you in?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I don't need your help getting a date! How pathetic do you think I am?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jessica! Not the time!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: In case you hadn't heard, I'm dating a really cool college guy who graduated from here last year.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... Right... That creepy 'Spud' guy.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Spud's `not` creepy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Spud's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] creepy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure, sure... Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, okay, so you don't need help getting a date. Is there any way we can persuade you to help us?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I `have` been meaning to test out some new hacking software... Maybe if you ask `very` nicely, I'll let you use it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] been meaning to test out some new hacking software... Maybe if you ask [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] nicely, I'll let you use it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is humiliating...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please? Please help us, Kat.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Okay, fine. Move over.
Linda turns and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoa. That was pretty intense.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but it doesn't change anything. Particularly since I've got a brilliant scheme lined up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oooh, what are we doing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're going to hack Linda's FaceSpace account.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is that even legal?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who cares? Come on... Let's go take over one of the library computers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, what could Linda's password be?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let me try.
After ten minutes of trying to guess Linda's password...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, this is impossible!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't get it... We've tried every teen hearthrob's first, last, and middle name! What could her password be?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Um, I couldn't help overhearing. Are you two `really` trying to just guess someone's password?
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, I couldn't help overhearing. Are you two [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] trying to just guess someone's password?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... Yeah. So what?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That's hilarious. Didn't you know? Almost everyone uses numbers and capitalization in their passwords.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: It's almost impossible to just guess it. You've got to have a program that helps you try all the different combinations.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... What, you can help us?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Maybe. I'm not crazy about Linda, ever since her friend Dinah stole my boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: But what's in it for me?

options.label: We can set you up on a date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You might not know me, but I know who `you` are! You've been making life miserable for my cousin since she started here!
nodes.text_bbcode: You might not know me, but I know who [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are! You've been making life miserable for my cousin since she started here!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh? Your cousin?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I've seen the way you treat Howard and Kenji. It's terrible! Just make a decision and stick with it! You're just making everyone suffer.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I might not be the best person in the world, but I never did anything to deserve those rumors.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Those rumors were just the beginning, lady! You better leave Howard alone, or `else!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Those rumors were just the beginning, lady! You better leave Howard alone, or [color=#3b78e2][i]else![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Or else what?! I'm not afraid of a little pip squeak like you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I come from a big family of girls, kid. I know how to stand up for myself. Don't think you can start pushing me around!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But look, I didn't confront you to scream at you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I just want you to leave me alone, okay? Just drop it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why would I be spreading rumors about you? Maybe Amanda was confused... You know how she gets.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess... Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heh heh... She bought it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, it's possible I `do` have the wrong girl, but all the same... If it `is` you or one of your friends, please just stop.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's possible I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] have the wrong girl, but all the same... If it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] you or one of your friends, please just stop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, that was it! I guessed her password! It really is $LINDAPASSWORD!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What a stupid password. Come on, $LINDAPASSWORD? Really?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe I just guessed it. And $LINDAPASSWORD is so random. How did I even think of it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You must be psychic or something...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know, I did have this feeling... I was thinking really hard about what Linda would think if she was making a password...
Suddenly, the doors to the library burst open!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's her! That girl over there!
Two men dressed in black uniforms run up and grab Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's going on? Let go of me!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Well, if she's going to be difficult, we'd better sedate her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sedate?! What...?
One of the men gives Sam an injection...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let... Go... Of... Uggggnnnnhhhh.
Some indeterminate amount of time later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ughhh. Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Let me be the first to welcome you to the underground division of Price Labs.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: As part of my internship, I'm running a study on latent psychic abilities.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Prisoner 121, you've shown an amazing aptitude for psychic manipulation.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Hey, I've got a name!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Exactly. And that name is Prisoner 121.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: No! My name is Sam.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Are you sure about that, Prisoner 121?

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Yes!
Steph makes a note on her clipboard.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Hmm. Prisoner 121 is reacting poorly to reality reorientation.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Hey, I can hear you talking about me!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Subject is prone to paranoia.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: It's not paranoia if you really locked me up!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Recommending combat testing immediately.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Combat testing?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Sedating subject to move her to gladiatorial pits.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: I wish you'd stop... Ughhh...

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Uhgggh, where am I now?

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 113
nodes.text: Sam. I guess they got you, too.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Andy? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 113
nodes.text: The same thing you're doing. Fighting!

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: But... I don't want to fight... I just want to go home...

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 113
nodes.text: Sorry, Prisoner 121. I can't go easy on you. They briefed me on your file. Sounds like you're quite the mind reader.
Prisoner 113 raises his hand and two boulders rise off the ground!

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 113
nodes.text: Let's see if that's a match for my telekinesis.

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: It was just a lucky guess, okay?

nodes.speaker: Prisoner 121
nodes.text: Let me out of here! I don't belong here! It was just a stupid, lucky guess!
Uh oh... Looks like sometimes it's not good to be `too` lucky.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh oh... Looks like sometimes it's not good to be [b]too[/b] lucky.

nodes.text: But we better get out of this ending before Steph turns Sam into some kind of psychic weapon!

args.text: Surviving High School
Congratulations on finding the bonus scene!

nodes.text: Sam and $ZOE are walking to class when they see Linda talking to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This week has been so stressful... I'm just so... So sorry about everything...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw, Linda...
Howard gives Linda a hug.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't cry. It's all going to be okay, sweetheart. I'll take care of you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's going on with Howard and Linda?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, didn't you hear? Linda's got some conspiracy theory that someone's out to get her, and it made her have this total breakdown.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now she's got Howard totally wrapped around her finger! He won't leave her side because he's worried something will happen to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! But... That's not...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whatever, just forget it. It's clear that Howard `really` wants to be with Linda. I might as well start looking for someone else to take to the Sadie Hawkins Dance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever, just forget it. It's clear that Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] wants to be with Linda. I might as well start looking for someone else to take to the Sadie Hawkins Dance.

nodes.text: $ZOE looks around...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I really messed up... Everything I did just pushed Howard and Linda closer together! And now it's all my fault that he's not with $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I'd done better, I bet I could've gotten Linda to give up.
Sam's plan completely backfired! And it's all because of you!
Do you really want to let it end this way?
Try again and see if you can get a better ending for Sam and $ZOE!

nodes.text: The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh. It's not 'Kenji'. Maybe Linda really is over him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really thought it might be 'Howard'... Maybe they had nicknames for each other...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I bet I'm close...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I bet it's 'Howie' plus some kind of sickeningly cute animal nickname.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, did you really think it would be 'Password'? Even Linda's not that stupid.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Um, why did you think Linda's password would be your name?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... Just checking.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, Sam. The world doesn't revolve around you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Um, why would Linda's password be 'Linda'? That doesn't make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I guess Linda' isn't obsessed with this rivalry with $ZOE... That's good to know.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You are in a library. Exits are in front of you and to the left, but you can't leave until you figure out the password.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess $LINDAPASSWORD isn't the password.
The next day at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. What did you have in mind for today?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda's such a popular girl... I want to ruin her reputation by the end of the day.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: With a nasty rumor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oooh, I like it. Let's do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, here's the most important part. Who do we use to spread it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... We could start with someone popular. That would really get the rumor to spread.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Or we can try to convince some freshmen. They'll believe anything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's start with...
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, what's your plan for today?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! You!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda? What...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Amanda told me she heard you spreading rumors about me in the cafeteria yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I know you guys were messing with my gym locker.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So I want to know. Why me? What's your problem? I don't even really know you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What should I do?

nodes.text: Welcome back to Centerscore High! Today you'll be playing as Sam, $ZOE's cousin.
With the Sadie Hawkins Dance coming up at the end of the month, all the girls are looking for guys to ask...
The only problem is that someone's already got their sights on $ZOE's guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygoodness! Linda's over there talking to Howard `again!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygoodness! Linda's over there talking to Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]again![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!
Across the hall...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hi, Howard! Hee hee, you've got a 'Property of Kay and Kel' sign on your back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, man! Last week it was 'Kick me' signs... The twins are in `so` much trouble when I get home...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, man! Last week it was 'Kick me' signs... The twins are in [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] much trouble when I get home...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh. Remember when your sisters made us play 'Princess Princess Lovely' with them? I can't believe you won.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha! It was my solemn duty to assume the tiara during those troubled times...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, she's `always` around him. It's so unfair. They've got so much history together, I don't have a chance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, she's [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] around him. It's so unfair. They've got so much history together, I don't have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what can I do? It's a hopeless situation... Maybe I shouldn't even ask Howard to the Sadie Hawkins Dance...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If another girl was after `my` man, I know `exactly` what I'd do. But I bet $ZOE's way too much of a goody-goody to make Linda back off.
nodes.text_bbcode: If another girl was after [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] man, I know [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] what I'd do. But I bet $ZOE's way too much of a goody-goody to make Linda back off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, what should I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you should...

nodes.text: Let me try again.
Late that night, Sam hears her phone ringing...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ugnnhh? I mean, hello?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Remember when you said you'd owe me one?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Huh? Oh. Right.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, I'm outside your house, and it's time to pay up!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What? Right now?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yes, sleepy head! Get your butt out of bed and get down here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This can't be good.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, when I said I'd owe you one, I meant, like, you could copy my biology notes or I'd babysit for your brother or something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Not` that you could come over to my house at two in the morning!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Not[/i][/color] that you could come over to my house at two in the morning!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeesh, don't be such a poor sport. I just need you to come with me to this totally awesome fashion line launch.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm going to need some help holding all of my shopping bags, and that's where you come in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The doors open at three, so we'd better get down there if we want to be first in line.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Three? Three in the morning?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll be home by dawn... I promise.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dawn?! But... I need to sleep...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, this line launching is going to be a massacre. Girls will be trampling each other just to get to the mannequins!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm going to need someone there to watch my back.
Three hours later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Sleepy...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam! Grab these boots! Hold on to this trench coat!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hey, I saw that trench coat first!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ouch! Let go of my hair!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Back off!
Jessica pushes Porscha away.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See? This crowd is brutal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Tell me about it.
After an hour of frantic shopping...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay, you baby. We're home. Get some rest! See you at school!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even my bruises have bruises on them! Ouch!
And only a few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Time to wake up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ughhh.
After a very strong cup of coffee, Sam and $ZOE make it to school...

nodes.text: Sam and $ZOE are headed to their lockers when Jessica runs up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, I've got a great idea for the next prank on Linda. We call her parents, pretending to be Howard's parents...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And we say that we found a reservation for a honeymoon suite in Vegas!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `And` a ring!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] a ring!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's the perfect prank! She'll be grounded for the rest of her life.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's it! I heard everything you said, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh. Well. This is awkward.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't get it... I never did anything to any of you. How can you be so mean to me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mean? Sam, what's she talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? $ZOE doesn't know?! We've been working all week to ruin Linda's life for her, and you didn't even tell her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jessica! I knew $ZOE wouldn't approve!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is a total mess. I'm out of here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... Um... The thing is, $ZOE, I knew you weren't going to fight for Howard the way you should...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I thought I'd do what I could to level the playing field a little.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you did this by hurting Linda?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you'd do this! Linda's never done anything bad to `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you'd do this! Linda's never done anything bad to [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In fact, this whole time that you've been at war with her, did she even `once` retaliate?
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, this whole time that you've been at war with her, did she even [color=#3b78e2][i]once[/i][/color] retaliate?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... No... I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, just perfect. I guess Linda's as much of a goody-goody as `you` are, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, just perfect. I guess Linda's as much of a goody-goody as [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Linda, I'm really sorry that Sam and Jessica were messing with you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This has been the worst week of my life!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was really depressed and hurt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I get it! Stop making me feel guilty!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look, you've got to promise that you're going to leave me alone from now on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! I promise. I'm really sorry, okay?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... All right.
Linda walks off and $ZOE turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I know you think I give up too easy, and maybe you're right, maybe I do need to fight for Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I need to fight for Howard `my` way.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I need to fight for Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I guess I understand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just wanted you to be happy. I really thought I was helping you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I guess I really went about it the wrong way, huh?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry I messed up, $ZOE.
$ZOE gives Sam a hug!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... You might have been totally wrong about what you did... But in your own way, it was kind of sweet. Thanks for looking out for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah.
Just then, Howard waves at Sam and $ZOE and walks over.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You'll never believe the crazy week I've been having. I'm so tired of all the drama.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, I'm sorry. It sounds like you've had a tough time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But hey, forget about that. Why don't you let me buy you a cup of coffee after school, and you can tell me all about it? Maybe we can figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. I'll see you after school... But `I'm` buying. I've got to compensate you for giving me advice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks, $ZOE. I'll see you after school... But [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] buying. I've got to compensate you for giving me advice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. Okay.
$ZOE gives Howard a quick hug.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. I know I can always count on you to cheer me up. You're the best.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, there's the bell. I guess I better run to class. I've got to get across campus, and Ms. Prez says I've got detention for a week if I'm late again.
Howard waves and runs off to class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. I guess your good-girl method pays off...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Every now and then.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I still don't agree with it, but if it works for you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not sure yet whether it'll work... But I've got to be myself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Sam? Maybe you should use all of that conniving to fight for someone `you` like.
nodes.text_bbcode: And Sam? Maybe you should use all of that conniving to fight for someone [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] like.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Meh. I'm over the whole relationship thing. Besides, the last guy I got seriously involved with...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, never mind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What were you going to say?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just that he was nothing but trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't that most high school guys?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah, sure. But some are a whole different kind of trouble...

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: To be more specific, you played a perfect game!
Congratulations! Here's a bonus scene that'll give you a hint about who's coming in the next episode...
One afternoon at a remote boot camp for troubled teens...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: So, today's your last day, eh?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, sir.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Great. I hate this part... Turning you kids lose on the street.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What, you don't have faith that all the long hours hauling rocks here set me straight?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean, it really taught me the value of hard work or something, right?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Don't mock my boot camp!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You'll be back here, troublemaker! Mark my words.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: For some kids, they come here and it changes them. They're scared straight.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But you... You're a troublemaker through and through.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Picking fights, stealing cars... I know your type. You couldn't stay out of trouble if you tried.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who said I was going to try?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Delinquent! You'll be back in here in a week!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, sir.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Next time, I won't get caught.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Get out of here! I'm just sorry for whoever has to take you in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'm going somewhere pretty nice...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Since I've been kicked out of every military school and boarding school from here to the state line, my parents finally have to put me in public school.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you know, I've got a girl out there that I've been meaning to look up...
Whoa! Looks like there's trouble headed for Centerscore High...
But you'll have to wait till the next episode to find out what happens!
See you next time!

nodes.text_bbcode: Be sure to check out our new Premium Content, [b]Hector's Guide to Girls[/b]! Enroll in Hector's seminar, and you'll find out how to score a date the Surviving High School way!

nodes.text: Sam is walking with $ZOE to her locker...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ohmygoodness, it's that $ZOE girl! I heard she totally made out with the entire Wilson High football team!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I heard she's so desperate for a date to the school dance that she's going with Travis!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I heard she's going with her cousin's dog! She's going to dress him up in a tux and everything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh? Why are people spreading so many rumors about me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's... Totally weird... And probably in no way retaliation for something I did this week...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Oh, nevermind. We've got to get to class. Let me just grab my books...
$ZOE opens up her locker, and a bucket of paint falls down, covering her books and papers!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eek! What is this?! My homework! It's all ruined!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It looks like someone's declaring war...
Just then, Ryan comes up and puts an arm around $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, baby. How about we skip class and do some makin' out behind the Auto-Shop?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ryan?! Eww... Get off of me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Come on, now, baby. Is that any way to talk to your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Boyfriend?!` What are you talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Boyfriend?![/i][/color] What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You know... That little request you sent me late last night on FaceSpace.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't send you any request!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not here to judge what you did or didn't do. All I know is that on FaceSpace, it says you're my girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And if it says it on FaceSpace, then that makes it true.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Now, pucker up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ew ew ew!
$ZOE runs off, Ryan chasing after her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is a complete mess... Poor $ZOE... I was only trying to help her...
Wow. It's almost like you're `trying` to ruin $ZOE's life!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. It's almost like you're [b]trying[/b] to ruin $ZOE's life!

nodes.text: Sam doesn't want all of these bad things to happen to her cousin!
Try again and see if you can get a better ending... One where $ZOE doesn't end up dating Ryan!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
